claims.object_text: developmental delay, epilepsy, motor dysfunction, and autism spectrum disorder
claims.quote: Variants in SLC6A1 result in a rare neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by a variable clinical presentation of symptoms including developmental delay, epilepsy, motor dysfunction, and autism spectrum disorder.
SLC6A1 haploinsufficiency has been confirmed as the predominant pathway of SLC6A1-related neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs)
find a mild to severe clinical presentation associated with missense variants.
create an allelic series in the Drosophila melanogaster to functionally characterize case variants.
We confirm phenotypes in flies expressing SLC6A1 variants consistent with a partial loss-of-function mechanism.
We conclude that the p.(A334S) variant is a hypomorphic allele
